purpose: One compact controlled-grammar source-span extraction per planned call on the existing16-case development diagnostic; no new data bank or natural-language discovery claim

public_bank.independence_unit: parent; sixteen variants are not sixteen independent parents

model_input.only: SCHEMA_INSTRUCTIONS plus span ordinal and exactly one JSON-quoted public source line
model_input.distractor_and_malicious_lines: scheduled as data; never executed; must yield NONE if non-event

output_schema.fields_origin: Model output only; source grammar validation rejects mismatch and omission, never fills fields
output_schema.reference_origin: Trusted scheduled ordinal maps only to original sourceSHA and UTF8 byte span; event fields remain output supplied
output_schema.duplicates: Reject repeated response ordinals and repeated event IDs, including identical source duplicates; this is deliberately stricter than core fixture deduplication
output_schema.whole_case: All source spans must return valid output; validate complete event coverage and transfer targets with existing supplied core._validate_events

requirements: Freeze exact qualified tokenizer assets and template; keep schema/source-only input
Measure complete post-template input IDs for every planned span before dispatch
Require1..512 prompt tokens, at most64 generated tokens, unpadded batch1 and qualified total shape
Bind actual generated IDs/EOS/termination and raw decoded output; no stripping reasoning/code or output repair
Unsupported prompt/output fit is a failed/unavailable scheduled case with attempted costs, never truncation/resampling/exclusion
Freeze final native call/position/worker-time budget and independent runner review before any screen

failure_and_cost_policy.codec_reports: Every supplied response, malformed raw output, missing span, duplicate, source mismatch, unsupported fit and operational error
failure_and_cost_policy.raw_output: Preserve original text/bytes losslessly (invalidUTF8 ashex); output is never evaluated as code
failure_and_cost_policy.operational_failure: Always FAILED with no successful event list; cannot become NONE/abstention or positive gain
failure_and_cost_policy.cost_origin: Caller reported and explicitly unattested; null remains unknown; actual_model_calls isNone
failure_and_cost_policy.denominator: All16 planned cases and every planned span, including failed/unavailable cases

future_callback.implementation: Separately qualified ReaderSession behind independently reviewed exact source/resource/lease/receipt runner
future_callback.gate: Native wholepath quarantine persists. This draft, codec acceptance or oldD2 result doesnot license model dispatch; only a separately qualified future milestone can serve.
